evidence.quote: Flowering time is midsummer (Oct.-Jan.)... deep purplish black when fully ripe at the beginning of winter (May to June).

harvestMonths.notes: PZA's Rhoicissus page covers several species (R. tomentosa, R. digitata, R. tridentata, R. rhomboidea, R. sessilifolia) in separate sections; only the R. tomentosa-specific section's text was used here, not the other species' sections. Flowering is Oct-Jan (months [10,11,12,1] for reference only, not the harvested product); fruit ripens May-June.

chillUnits.notes: Evergreen/semi-deciduous forest-margin liana; no source discusses a chilling requirement.

pollination.notes: No source found (PZA description, ICRAF Agroforestree switchboard search) states flower sex structure or a self-fertile/cross-pollinator/dioecious statement for this species.
